name_input: ELGI EQUIPMENTS LTD.; ELGI EQUIPMENTS LIMITED
export_evidence: No shipment-level record could be read. ImportKey page https://importkey.com/countries/india/elgi-equipments-ltd returned only the shell text 'Shipments available for ELGI EQUIPMENTS LTD, refreshed daily' with 0 data rows rendered (JS-gated); volza, eximpedia, importgenius and trademo all returned HTTP 403 / JS challenge, so 0 bill-of-lading rows were actually seen. No B/L number, date, destination or HS code could be quoted. Company's own site states only a general claim: 'ELGi is a pioneer and a global leader in cutting-edge compressed air technology with presence across more than 100 countries' (https://www.elgi.com/in/investors/) — this is a claim, not a shipment record.
domestic_evidence: Legal entity existence is confirmed by the CIN printed in the site footer: 'CIN : L29120TZ1960PLC000351' (https://www.elgi.com/in/investors/), and the company publishes audited standalone/consolidated results and annual reports (https://www.elgi.com/in/financials/ — 'ELGi Annual Report 2018 - 2019 DOWNLOAD', '2026 - 27 H1 H1 2026-27 Assets and Liability DOWNLOAD'). However the annual-report PDFs are binary and could not be parsed by the fetch tool, so no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or contract figure was actually read. Domestic supply therefore remains declared, not confirmed at record level.
note: HS 841440 (air compressors) is consistent with the actual product line (rotary screw / reciprocating / portable air compressors), so the claimed industry label 'IT и электроника' is wrong and should be corrected to mechanical engineering / compressed air equipment — per rule 3 this is not a rejection ground. Entity is a listed, long-established manufacturer (CIN L29120TZ1960PLC000351, incorporated 1960, Coimbatore/Tamil Nadu), not a trader, so role = manufacturer. Revenue and export volume: null — no public figure was actually read in this session (annual-report PDFs unparseable, BSE page returned no content), so per rule 4 they are left null rather than estimated. Shipment evidence: 'следов поставок не найдено' at record level in the sources reachable here — this is a tool-access limitation (all four trade-data providers blocked), not a finding that shipments do not exist; status kept as unknown rather than none_found for that reason. Recommend re-check with a paid/API trade-data source or a text-extractable annual report before finalising.
